english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a vegetable, whether referring to the plant or its edible part.

examples.english: This vegetable is one I bought at the market.
examples.traditional: 呢棵菜係我喺街市買嘅。
examples.jyutping: nei1 fo2 coi3 hai6 ngo5 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 ge3

english.note: Use this for a named cuisine or culinary tradition, as in 法國菜 for French cuisine.
Use this when cooking means a cuisine or culinary style, especially in expressions such as 中國菜.

examples.english: The Sichuan kitchen at this restaurant is really good.
examples.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 cyun1 coi3 hou2 zeng3
ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 zung1 gwok3 coi3
